mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for at least 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.3 percentage points in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a short-term sell-off in equities, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 6-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and housing starts by more than 1.5% in a month indicates a broad-based supply shock that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both INDPRO and HOUST decline by >1.5% in the same month, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.01 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by high retail sales growth, a sustained increase in retail sales above 0.8% monthly growth signals strong consumer demand that supports equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of periods when RSAFS growth exceeds 0.8% in a month and the economy is in a late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% and is rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 6-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth and rise in unemployment rate by more than 0.2pp in a month indicates a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS growth declines and UNRATE rises by >0.2pp in the same month, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.01 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime, a decline in industrial production by more than 1.0% in a month signals reduced corporate output capacity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines by >1.0% and the economy is in a manufacturing slowdown regime, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 6-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales growth above 0.5% monthly growth signals strong consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS growth exceeds 0.5% monthly, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-month rolling window.
